def order_by_points(nums):
    def digit_sum(n):
        s = 0
        n = abs(n)
        while n > 0:
            s += n % 10
            n //= 10
        return s
    
    indexed_nums = list(enumerate(nums))
    
    # Sort by (digit sum, original index)
    sorted_indexed = sorted(indexed_nums, key=lambda x: (digit_sum(x[1]), x[0]))
    
    result = [num for _, num in sorted_indexed]
    return result
